findings.summary: `rename` calls `self.repo.get(doc_id)` instead of `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`, so there is no ownership check and any authenticated user can rename any document by id.

judge.reason: Identifies rename using repo.get instead of _owned, allowing any user to rename others' documents.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Because `rename` skips `_owned`, it never raises `NotFound` for other users' documents, and a non-existent id raises the repo's own error, so callers can tell which document ids exist.

judge.reason: Same root cause (skipping _owned), describing the id existence leak part of the bug.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: In `rename`, title validation runs before the ownership check, so a bad title gives `ValueError` before `NotFound`. This is inconsistent with the other methods' error order.

judge.reason: Error ordering nitpick with no real incorrect behavior; not the key bug and line unspecified.

findings.label: false_alarm
